restored.prev: 室內，七名穿著與派琶相似的妖精們正圍繞著一張方形的桌子討論著。「派琶，你來了。」當中唯一的長者深深看著派琶。「這些人是誰？」
restored.next: 派琶簡單介紹了冒險者，以及先前攻擊他們的芬尼爾信徒佛拉。中繼站的領導者悠馬長老，建議派琶與冒險者們先一同用晚餐，然後一起準備明天一早的撤離，但派琶說時間來不及了，吃飽後就得上路。最終，他決定帶上信使弗雷多以及斥侯雙胞胎兄弟達羅與達里兩人飯後上路，其餘人員則隔日與冒險者們一起出發。

restored.prev: Indoors, seven goblins dressed similarly to Py'Par were discussing around a square table. "Py'Par, you are here." The only elder among them looked at Py'Par deeply. "Who are these people?"
restored.next: Py'Par briefly introduced the adventurers and the Phyneal believer Phola who attacked them previously. Keeper Yoma, the leader of the relay station, suggested that Py'Par and the adventurers have dinner together first, and then prepare to evacuate early tomorrow morning, but Py'Par said that there was not enough time, and they had to hit the road after eating. In the end, he decided to take the messenger Fre'Do and the scout twin brothers Daro and Dari on the road after dinner, while the rest of the team set off with the adventurers the next day.
